ABOUT.HEADING: About Me
ABOUT.TEXT: I'm Kevin Metzdorf – Senior Shopify Developer specialized in technical rescue missions, performance optimization, and clean, scalable theme architectures. I support agencies and brands when Shopify projects become complex, stability is paramount, or rapid, resilient solutions are required. My commitment: clear communication, structured execution, and code that remains maintainable six months down the line. From targeted fixes to long-term partnerships – always pragmatic, reliable, and drama-free.
ABOUT.RESCUE_TEXT: Technical Rescue – When a project is stuck: Analysis, debugging, and stabilization – fast and efficient.
ABOUT.PERFORMANCE_TEXT: Performance & Maintainability – Load times, code quality, and scalable theme structures for growing brands.

SKILLS.HEADING: Skills
SKILLS.TEXT: I am an experienced web developer with a dedicated focus on e-commerce and bespoke Shopify solutions. Over the years, I have optimized and scaled numerous online stores, always prioritizing high code quality, peak performance, and seamless user experiences. My approach combines agile methodology with pragmatic solutions that deliver tangible business value.
